# polaris_policy_grant (Resource)

Manage one explicit policy privilege for one catalog role. This does not replace other grants or remove inherited access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_policy_grant" "example" {
  catalog      = "warehouse"
  namespace    = ["sales"]
  catalog_role = "iam_analysts"
  policy_name  = "chosen"
  privilege    = "POLICY_READ"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Existing catalog name.
- `catalog_role` (String) Catalog role receiving this privilege; direct identity grants are not supported.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace path components; a literal dot remains part of its component.
- `policy_name` (String) Existing object name.
- `privilege` (String) Polaris 1.9 privilege at this scope.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import polaris_policy_grant.example '{"catalog":"warehouse","catalog_role":"iam_analysts","grant":{"type":"policy","privilege":"POLICY_READ","namespace":["sales"],"policyName":"chosen"}}'
```
